description: Edit a Reddit ad, including a LIVE one: rename it, point it at a different post, change its click url, set or clear its UTM / tracking parameters (clickUrlQueryParameters; pass null to clear), switch on or refresh its PREVIEW link (previewDays 1-30, read back as previewUrl; previewOff:true switches it off), replace its third-party event trackers, or for a catalog ad change its shoppingCreative / featured productIds. Does not activate or pause it — use set_reddit_ads_status. Swapping the post changes what people see, so confirm the new creative with the user first — and Reddit does NOT move the click url with the post, so the reply says where clicks still go. The reply also carries Reddit’s rejection reason when the ad was rejected. The result is read back from Reddit.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

adId.description: id of the ad to edit

clickUrl.description: pass an empty string to clear it

clickUrlQueryParameters.description: UTM / tracking parameters, e.g. {"utm_source":"reddit","utm_content":"{{AD_ID}}"} (≤14); null clears them

eventTrackers.description: replaces the third-party trackers (Reddit-approved providers only)

type.description: CLICK or VIEW: when the third-party tracker fires

url.description: third-party measurement URL from a Reddit-approved provider

previewDays.description: 1-30: (re)enable the preview link for this many days

previewOff.description: true switches the preview link off

productIds.description: catalog ads: up to 6 featured product ids

redditProfileId.description: Reddit profile id (t2_...) the ad runs as

shoppingCreative.description: catalog ads: same fields as create_reddit_ads_ad

name: update_reddit_ads_ad
title: Edit a Reddit ad
